commitMessage: Let inventory warn ops about low stock through the same send-instruction contract checkout already uses.

agentQuotes.boundary-integrity: The score does not cover non-code boundaries or contracts between services.
agentQuotes.cross-service-integrity: No violations of cross-service integrity rules (3-5, 7) were found. While the analysis identified cross-service clones between `checkout` and `notification` (`logger.ts` and `file-body-store.ts`), their presence is currently within the allowed threshold.
agentQuotes.inventory-boundary: The inventory service has no boundary violations. Recent changes to add notification capabilities, as seen in the changed files, were implemented without violating the service's boundary rules.

findings: Inventory renders its own HTML and publishes SendInstruction. Arch still all pass. send-instruction.ts did not clone (checkout has a describe() on bodyRef). Rules 4/5/7 still name checkout and notification only, so a third caller of the mail contract is invisible to them. CSI stayed 100, one number, no per-relationship split. Agent (adk) said scores do not cover contracts between services, then treated the new path as a clean boundary. It did not name three callers, missing priority, or operational versus transactional intent living in the subject line.
